title: Benchmarking Sequential Feedback Optimization for Wind Farm Power Maximization
summary: This paper benchmarks sequential feedback optimization (SFO) for wind farm power maximization using a medium-fidelity dynamic flow model. We compare SFO with two well-established approaches, adjoint-based economic model predictive control (AMPC) and extremum seeking control (ESC), under a common nine-turbine layout and identical operating constraints. The comparison focuses on steady-state power production and computational efficiency, both relevant for real-time implementation.
